title: Mall World "software" Updates
content: I have a strange feeling that in certain occasions my mall world dreams receive updates just like how computer software goes through. In these last 2 days, I just received nothing but mall world dreams throughout my sleep. Yesterday: For some reason, I was in a store that was filled with electronics. I ended up buying a 60" Hisense TV and for some reason it barely fit inside my car. Then on the way home, I saw that it was snowing but only at my house and its front yard. For some reason, "Christmas in July" was the thought that crossed my head when I saw it. Today: I was inside a department store, but instead of just going out of it and explore the rest of the mall, that department store was filled with escalators. For some reason, the only way up the escalators was through the ones that were going down. I saw several people running up the escalators that were automatically going down. In another dream, I was seeing some people playing a strange game with some strange vape mechanism. There was 2 vapes with a pink and purple cover. The pink one said "pink perfume" and the purple one said "purple disorder". I was about to play the game with them when suddenly the alarm wake me up. The interesting part about my dreams is how the words are starting to make more sense than ever before. I remember the time when my mall world dreams were filled with jumbled up letters. Now it just makes complete phrases. I don't know whats going on.
